title: Desigualdad y pobreza
goal: Read how 1990s macroeconomic recovery -- lower inflation, renewed growth -- coexisted with persistent or worsening inequality, ECLAC's "growth without equity" critique, and Latin America's world-leading Gini coefficients.

items: Describe what many countries achieved macroeconomically in the 1990s.
Explain what the Gini coefficient showed about the region.
Explain what ECLAC meant by "growth without equity".
Describe the trend in wealth concentration during this decade.
Use aun así to acknowledge a contrast despite what precedes it.
